title: Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez Shares a Thanksgiving Greeting for Webb County
excerpt: Webb County shared a Thanksgiving greeting Tuesday from Precinct 1 Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez ahead of the holiday on Thursday.
content:
Webb County shared a Thanksgiving greeting Tuesday morning from Precinct 1 Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez, wishing residents a happy Thanksgiving ahead of the holiday on Thursday, Nov. 26.

The greeting was posted to the county's Facebook page on Tuesday, Nov. 24.
